objective: Prevent an Android prototype VPN without a forwarding core from being selectable as Always-on VPN, without modifying any owner network/device.

factualProblem.finding: Android VpnService component had no SERVICE_META_DATA_SUPPORTS_ALWAYS_ON false. Android's default for a VpnService supporting Android 8.1+ is true, despite providerCoreReady()=false. In Android settings this could misleadingly appear eligible for Always-on.
factualProblem.scope: Risk of user selecting a nonfunctional VPN; actual Always-on enrollment or traffic failure on a physical device was NOT observed.
